scenes.name: 独立通道 · 净空 0.40 m

geometry.name: corridor-040
geometry.title: 净空 0.40 m 通道
geometry.description: Standalone constructed open-ended covered corridor and 6 x 4 m floor; 4 m length, 2 m interior width; only corridor height differs between variants. Not a simulated LiDAR scan.

timings.note: One CPU run, single-thread BLAS. Includes patch geometry and all assessment stages; excludes source generation, file IO and browser rendering. Not the old fit-only benchmark.

jump_methods.A: max of two one-sided quadratic endpoint prediction residuals
jump_methods.B: two disjoint half-plane fits evaluated at the same candidate midpoint
jump_methods.C: method B + 2*sigma_delta; significance is separate, not traversability

scenes.uncertainty: Finite-ridge sandwich covariance, RSS/(n-6), 3 mm noise floor; prediction variance phi.T@cov@phi. Conditional linear-model estimate, not calibrated sensor uncertainty.
scenes.clearance: Observed occupied 5 cm columns in a 15 cm footprint, 10..60 cm above fitted surface. Raw points plus vertices of actual fitted triangles. Sampled surface evidence, not exact continuous collision detection or certified free space.
scenes.body: 80 cm along X, 50 cm along Y, assumed feet +/-35 cm and +/-20 cm; COM height 30 cm. Geometric quasi-static proxy only; no dynamics/friction/real mass model.
scenes.unknown: NaN in binaries / empty in CSV. Unsupported jump sides and body coverage are never zero-filled.
